column6: No requirements needed. Food is offered. Head over at any time.

UF students, faculty, or staff may enter weekly. There is no income verification. Enter, and grab a basket on the left. Foods are assigned point values(e.g. protein = 4, canned goods = 6) which are indicated. Make sure your basket of items does not exceed the food point limit, at which point you give them your UFID, and will be directed to bagging your items. Tip: Restocks are on Wednesdays, and on Thursday mornings there is normally a line before the pantry opens.
This is located at the back of the GCM building. Knock on the silver window and someone will assist you.
